$comment: Central, machine-readable safe-area model for the global template overlays.
The rendering truth for these overlays lives in the sibling Vue components:
(progress bar, top). This file does NOT restate their geometry — the validator
measures each overlay's PAINTED rectangle live from the DOM (selector below), so
the zone can never drift from the CSS. What this file adds is the part a renderer
cannot express: which edges the overlay is anchored to, how much extra breathing
room (margins) author content must keep beyond the painted rect, the overlay's
z-index (to reason about front/behind), and the layouts where the overlay is not
drawn (so no zone is reserved there).
Coordinate system: CANVAS pixels. Origin = top-left of the fixed 980x552 Slidev
canvas (16:9). x grows right, y grows down. Margins are in canvas px and are
therefore viewport-independent: the validator converts the live viewport pixels
to canvas px with the single visual scale (viewportWidth / 980) before comparing.
This lives in the TOOLKIT (not the deck) on purpose: a presentation consumes it
read-only and cannot switch the protection off. Per-slide, per-overlay exceptions
are the only escape hatch (see the slides skill), and they are always reported,
